31985-perfect-control.creator: Unknown
31985-perfect-control.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. McClelland was clean-shaven. His uniform, treated against deterioration, was immaculate, but his body showed frail and bony through it. His face was long and hollow-cheeked, the eyes deep-set and bright. The head was like a skull, the nose an eagle's beak.

arxiv-2103-09449.title: Universal image segmentation for optical identification of 2D materials
arxiv-2103-09449.creator: Randy M. Sterbentz, Kristine L. Haley, Joshua O. Island
arxiv-2103-09449.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Randy M. Sterbentz, Kristine L. Haley, Joshua O. Island. Machine learning methods are changing the way data is analyzed. One of the most powerful and widespread applications of these techniques is in image segmentation wherein disparate objects of a digital image are partitioned and classified. Here we present an image segmentation program incorporating a series of unsupervised clustering algorithms for the automatic thickness identification of two-dimensional materials from digital optical microscopy images.

arxiv-2105-12722.title: Sli2Vol: Annotate a 3D Volume from a Single Slice with Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2105-12722.creator: Pak-Hei Yeung, Ana I.L. Namburete +, Weidi Xie +
arxiv-2105-12722.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pak-Hei Yeung, Ana I.L. Namburete +, Weidi Xie +. The objective of this work is to segment any arbitrary structures of interest (SOI) in 3D volumes by only annotating a single slice, ( i.e. semi-automatic 3D segmentation). We show that high accuracy can be achieved by simply propagating the 2D slice segmentation with an affinity matrix between consecutive slices, which can be learnt in a self-supervised manner, namely slice reconstruction.

arxiv-2204-13297.creator: Bjørn Kjos-Hanssen, David J. Webb
arxiv-2204-13297.description: Abstract While it is not known whether each real that is Kolmogorov-Loveland random is Martin-Löf random, i.e., whether KLR ⊆ MLR \KLR\subseteq\MLR , Kjos-Hanssen and Webb (2021) showed that MLR is truth-table Medvedev reducible ( ≤ s , t ​ t \leq_{s,tt} ) to KLR.

arxiv-2309-04334.title: On Frobenius structures in symmetric cones
arxiv-2309-04334.creator: Noemie Combe
arxiv-2309-04334.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Noemie Combe. We prove that in any strictly convex symmetric cone Ω \Omega there exists a non empty locus where the WDVV equation is satisfied (i.e. there exists a hyperplane being a Frobenius manifold). This result holds over any real division algebra (with a restriction to the rank 3 case if we consider the field 𝕆 \mathbb{O} ) but also on their linear combinations.

arxiv-2406-12287.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yongqiang Liu. Let X X be a complex smooth quasi-projective variety with an epimorphism ν : π 1 ​ ( X ) ↠ ℤ n \nu\colon\pi_{1}(X)\twoheadrightarrow\mathbb{Z}^{n} . arxiv-2509-14193.title: Gremban Expansion for Signed Networks: Algebraic and Combinatorial Foundations for Community–Faction Detection
arxiv-2509-14193.creator: Fernando Diaz-Diaz, Karel Devriendt, Renaud Lambiotte
arxiv-2509-14193.description: Abstract This article deals with the characterization and detection of community and faction structures in signed networks. We approach the study of these mesoscale structures through the lens of the Gremban expansion. This graph operation lifts a signed graph to a larger unsigned graph, and allows the extension of standard techniques from unsigned to signed graphs.

pmc-10708823.title: Evaluation of InSAR Tropospheric Delay Correction Methods in the Plateau Monsoon Climate Region Considering Spatial–Temporal Variability
pmc-10708823.creator: Qihang Yang, Xiaoqing Zuo, Shipeng Guo, Yanxi Zhao, Carmine Serio, Assefa M Melesse
pmc-10708823.description: The tropospheric delay caused by the temporal and spatial variation of meteorological parameters is the main error source in interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) applications for geodesy. To minimize the impact of tropospheric delay errors, it is necessary to select the appropriate tropospheric delay correction method for different regions.

pmc-11434510.title: Identification of Key Volatile Compounds in Tilapia during Air Frying Process by Quantitative Gas Chromatography–Ion Mobility Spectrometry
pmc-11434510.creator: Tianyu Chen, Yong Xue, Chunsheng Li, Yongqiang Zhao, Hui Huang, Yang Feng, Huan Xiang, Shengjun Chen, Angelo Antonio D’Archivio
pmc-11434510.description: Air frying as a new roasting technology has potential for roasted fish production. In this study, the changes in volatile compounds (VCs) during air frying of tilapia were studied by quantitative gas chromatography–ion mobility spectrometry, followed by the identification of key VCs based on their odor activity value (OAV).

pmc-11477036.title: Nobiletin, as a Novel PDE4B Inhibitor, Alleviates Asthma Symptoms by Activating the cAMP-PKA-CREB Signaling Pathway
pmc-11477036.creator: Yan Zhang, Yaping Yang, Huicong Liang, Yuerun Liang, Guixin Xiong, Fang Lu, Kan Yang, Qi Zou, Xiaomin Zhang, Guanhua Du, Ximing Xu, Jiejie Hao, Longshuang Huang
pmc-11477036.description: Asthma is a chronic airway inflammation that is considered a serious public health concern worldwide. Nobiletin (5,6,7,8,3′,4′-hexamethyl flavonoid), an important compound isolated from several traditional Chinese medicines, especially Citri Reticulatae Pericarpium, is widely used for a number of indications, including cancer, allergic diseases, and chronic inflammation. However, the mechanism by which nobiletin exerts its anti-asthmatic effect remains unclear.

pmc-11832237.title: Temporal trends in the prevalence, incidence, and mortality of cardiac amyloidosis in Korea over 12 years
pmc-11832237.creator: You-Jung Choi, Yun Jin Choi, Jieun Lee, Jah Yeon Choi, Geum Joon Cho, Jin Oh Na
pmc-11832237.description: OBJECTIVESThis study investigated the prevalence, incidence, and prognosis of cardiac amyloidosis (CA) in Korea.METHODSThis retrospective nationwide population-based study used the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service databases between 2008 and 2020. All patients diagnosed with amyloidosis were included, and those with a diagnosis of heart failure or cardiomyopathy were classified as having CA.

pmc-12589976.title: Impact of Exercise on Clonal Hematopoiesis
pmc-12589976.creator: Jessica M. Scott, Brandon L. Tsai, Caitlin Stewart, Stefan E. Eng, James R. White, Kelly L. Bolton, Ines Vaz-Luis, Julie Havas, Antonio Di Meglio, Anne-Laure Martin, Sandrine Boyault, Ruilin Wang, Jean Baptiste Micol, Luis A. Diaz, Paul C. Boutros, Lee W. Jones
pmc-12589976.description: BackgroundClonal hematopoiesis (CH) is more prevalent in cancer patients and is associated with excess all-cause mortality (ACM) risk compared to patients without CH. Interventions to mitigate risk are not available.ObjectivesThe objective of the study was to investigate whether exercise reduces CH prevalence and excess ACM risk of CH in cancer patients.

pmc-12608703.title: Digital Insights into Workplace Breastfeeding in Indonesia: A Google Trends Analysis of Barriers and Opportunities
pmc-12608703.creator: Ray Wagiu Basrowi, Tonny Sundjaya, Dessy Pratiwi, Nurfadilah M Rajab, Rachel Amanda, Heru Komarudin, Gassani Amalia, Tamás Decsi
pmc-12608703.description: Background/Objectives: Exclusive breastfeeding rates in Indonesia remain low, particularly among working mothers, despite government policies and the substantial contribution of women to the national economy. Inadequate workplace support, with only 21.5% of working mothers having access to proper lactation facilities, is a key barrier.

pmc-12655402.title: Novel Disulfiram-Loaded Metal–Organic Nanoparticles Inhibit Tumor Growth and Induce Immunogenic Cell Death of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-12655402.creator: Chung-Hui Huang, Xuejia Kang, Lang Zhou, Junwei Wang, Shuai Wu, Peizhen Sun, Qi Wang, Adam B Keeton, Pengyu Chen, Gary A Piazza, José Martínez Lanao
pmc-12655402.description: Background/Objectives: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is among the most aggressive subtypes, lacking estrogen, progesterone, and HER2 receptors, which limits the efficacy of targeted therapies. Standard treatments often fail due to rapid drug resistance and poor long-term outcomes. Repurposing approved drugs with anticancer potential offers a promising alternative.

pmc-12706038.title: Best practice recommendations and considerations for designing and electronically implementing event-driven diaries in clinical trials
pmc-12706038.creator: Florence D Mowlem, Jeremiah J Trudeau, Jill V Platko, Jos Bloemers, Emuella Flood, Jessica L Abel, Kelly Dumais, Paul O’Donohoe, Sabrina Grant, Ryan Naville-Cook, Onyekachukwu Illoh, Shannon D Keith, Jing Ju, Megan Fitter, Dorothee Oberdhan, Randall Winnette, Manuela Bossi, Naomi Suminski, Sonya Ere
pmc-12706038.description: Based on the literature and collective experience and consensus of the authors, this article provides a definition for an event-driven electronic diary (EDeD), outlines considerations for the use of EDeDs, and provides best practice recommendations for their design and implementation in clinical trials.

pmc-13117963.title: Tribocorrosion Behavior of Mg Alloys on Sliding Friction in Hank’s Balanced Salt Solution
pmc-13117963.creator: Eri Miura, Chihiro Shiraishi, Sachiko Hiromoto
pmc-13117963.description: The tribocorrosion behavior of AZ31 and WE43 was investigated during sliding wear tests in Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBSS) and pure water. While wear volume increased monotonically with load in air and water, HBSS exhibited a distinct non-monotonic trend; the maximum material loss occurred at the minimum load (0.98 N) and decreased at 2.94 N before rising again.

pmc-13272578.title: The effect of polyallergy on ancillary service use among postoperative patients with gynecologic malignancies
pmc-13272578.creator: Kaitlyn Coppetti, Madeline Petty, Allison R. Walker, Luis Alvarado, Sarah P. Huepenbecker, Nicholas Taylor, Ashley Graul
pmc-13272578.description: ObjectiveTo determine if polyallergy (four or more documented allergies in the electronic medical record [EMR]) is an independent predictor of ancillary service use.MethodsSingle institution, retrospective cohort study of patients who underwent surgery for gynecologic malignancy between 01/2016 and 05/2024. Demographics, comorbidities, surgical details, postoperative complications, and allergies were abstracted from the EMR.

pmc-13390379.title: Psychometric evaluation of the professional forensic stigma scale
pmc-13390379.creator: Ellen Vorstenbosch, Yvonne H. A. Bouman, Gemma Escuder-Romeva, Carolina Fellinghauer, Erik Bulten, Josep Maria Haro
pmc-13390379.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundProfessional stigma toward forensic mental healthcare service users may compromise care quality and negatively affect treatment and rehabilitation outcomes. Reliable role- and context-specific instruments are needed to assess professional stigma in settings where therapeutic and security responsibilities intersect.

pmc-13529838.title: Spoken language delay in toddlerhood predicts late childhood language outcomes in dyslexia: evidence from retrospective parent-report
pmc-13529838.creator: Eleanor R Palser, Nilgoun Bahar, Ellie Carpenter, Maya Bardorf, Margo Kersey, Rian Bogley, Sarah Inkelis, Pedro Pinheiro-Chagas, Boon-Lead Tee, Jessica DeLeon, Virginia E Sturm, Zachary A Miller, Maria Luisa Mandelli, Maria Luisa Gorno Tempini, Christa Pereira

pmc-13597149.title: Native earthworms and roe deer in temperate forests: Friends in the sun, foes in the shade
pmc-13597149.creator: Ludwig Lettenmaier, Nico Eisenhauer, Simone Cesarz, Christian Ammer, Anna Bucharova, Sebastian Dittrich, Ronja Hausmann, Daniel Kraus, Angelika Kölbl, Soumen Mallick, Giorgi Mamadashvili, Atle Mysterud, Kerstin Pierick, Rike Schwarz, Jörg Müller, Christian Ristok
pmc-13597149.description: Given increasing deer populations and rising canopy openness through tree mortality in European forests, understanding how these changes affect above‐belowground communities and ecosystem functioning is becoming more important. Earthworms comprise the largest animal biomass in European forest soils and play a central role in decomposition, carbon and nutrient cycling, and soil formation.

pmc-13672893.title: The role of inflammation in cerebral small vessel disease and vascular cognitive impairment, and therapeutic implications
pmc-13672893.creator: Robin B Brown, Stuart M Allan, Hugh S Markus
pmc-13672893.description: Background:Increasing evidence suggests that inflammation occurs in cerebral small vessel disease (SVD). Inflammation has been hypothesized to play a role in disease pathogenesis and also in progression to vascular cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID), suggesting that targeting inflammation may offer a novel treatment option.
